text:
Okay so we need some significant changes to this recipe.

1) I have a standard pizza stone (not cast iron) and you need to preheat the oven at 500, with the stone in for at least 30 min
2) I don't use olive oil on it. 
3) Pizza dough (trader joes preferred) can also be frozen, but needs to be thawed and sit out for a bit (current favorite method, defrost overnight in fridge, in the morning put it in a small cooler, towel on top, and a ice pack)
4) Need about 1 cup marinara sauce
5) I usually just use shredded cheese, the tomato (don't write beefstake, plain is ok), basil, fresh cheese, mushrooms, purple onion are all optional
6)I make the pizza on parchment paper which I place on top of the pizza dough, but the time you have is way too long. It's 5-10 minutes max
